name: Smoke Dissolve
description: Billowing smoke drifts in across the first clip, with lit tops, darker folds and wispy edges, and thickens until it covers the frame; as it thins out and drifts away, the second clip shows through. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the smoke drifts toward (it comes in from the opposite side); its length is how far it drifts, in frame heights (x right, y up)

params.name: scale
params.description: Size of the billows: more, smaller ones with a larger value

params.name: spread
params.description: How much the smoke rolls in from one side rather than everywhere at once

params.name: softness
params.description: Softness of the smoke: wispier, more see-through edges with a larger value

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the smoke, lit from above
